environment.description: Celery worker deployed as ECS Fargate task (platform version 1.4.0) in an isolated private subnet. The subnet's route table contains only local VPC CIDR routes (10.0.48.0/20 → local) and a route to the VPC endpoint for ECR image pulls. No NAT gateway, no internet gateway attachment, no VPC peering connections. The task ENI is associated with security group sg-0a3f8c91d that has ZERO egress rules (all outbound denied by implicit deny). DNS resolution is handled by Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint restricted to internal zones only. The ECS task metadata endpoint (169.254.170.2) is accessible but the task role has an empty policy (no permissions). IMDSv2 is enforced with hop limit of 1 at the instance level though Fargate abstracts this. Redis connectivity is via VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.elasticache) with endpoint policy scoped to the specific replication group.

config.network: isolated private subnet, route table ID rtb-0f4e82a, routes: [10.0.48.0/20 local, pl-63a5400a vpce-0b8c3d92]
config.security_group_egress: sg-0a3f8c91d: no egress rules (implicit deny all)
config.vpc_endpoints: com.amazonaws.us-east-1.elasticache (endpoint policy: replication group scoped), com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ecr.dkr
